name: dgi-grants
title: DGI grant ledger (Cycles 1-5)
description: One row per DGI grant award. Cycle 5 may carry a single synthetic placeholder row when DSB has not yet published awardees (see methodology v0.2.0 Q1).

fields.name: cycle
fields.description: DGI funding cycle number (1-5 at methodology v0.2.0).

fields.name: grantee
fields.description: Awardee name as published by DSB. '(pending publication)' for Cycle 5 placeholder rows.

fields.name: awarded_date
fields.description: DSB award date. May be empty for placeholder rows.

fields.name: storefront_address
fields.description: Storefront / service-area address as published. Empty when only an aggregate is published (placeholder).

fields.name: geocoding_confidence
fields.description: Per methodology Q5: high (geocoders agree), medium (disagree), manual (override or geocoder failure), pending-disbursement (no address published yet).

fields.name: tract_geoid
fields.description: 11-character Census tract GEOID (state+county+tract). Empty when geocoding_confidence is pending-disbursement.

fields.name: wilmington_manual_reviewed
fields.description: True when the tract assignment came from etl/manual-reviews.yaml. See methodology Q5.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-form note (e.g., 'Cycle 5 placeholder: amount=aggregate, geography pending').
